ladder.title: pixels as tensors
ladder.takeaway: Model input is a numeric tensor + discrete label; always check shape/scale first.

ladder.title: kNN baseline (no learning)
ladder.takeaway: Data has structure: kNN >> chance without any training.

ladder.title: linear softmax from scratch
ladder.takeaway: Learning finds class templates (rows of W); still no spatial prior.

ladder.title: MLP on flat pixels
ladder.takeaway: Nonlinearity helps some; still treats pixels as bag of values → need convolution.

ladder.title: hand convolution + feature maps
ladder.takeaway: Conv reuses local filters: orders-of-magnitude fewer params than dense spatial maps; edges emerge from simple kernels.

ladder.title: shallow CNN (LeNet spirit)
ladder.takeaway: End-to-end CNN uses spatial structure; should beat flat MLP under similar budget.

ladder.title: BatchNorm ablation
ladder.takeaway: BN changes trainability/lr robustness; compare curves not only final top1.

ladder.title: residual vs plain deep
ladder.takeaway: Residual path keeps deep nets optimizable — key 2015 breakthrough.

ladder.title: depthwise separable conv
ladder.takeaway: Factorizing conv buys efficiency; report params/latency with accuracy.

ladder.title: training recipe ablation
ladder.takeaway: Same model, different recipe → different top1/ECE; modern gains are often recipe.

ladder.title: Squeeze-and-Excitation
ladder.takeaway: Channel attention is a cheap pre-ViT way to reweight features.

ladder.title: minimal Vision Transformer
ladder.takeaway: Global attention works but is data-hungry without strong recipe/pretrain.

ladder.title: Mini ConvNeXt
ladder.takeaway: Modernized CNNs compete with ViTs; architecture is not settled on attention-only.

ladder.title: SimCLR-style contrastive SSL
ladder.takeaway: Labels optional: contrastive pretrain + linear probe measures representation quality.

ladder.title: prototype cosine (CLIP intuition)
ladder.takeaway: Cosine-to-prototype is the interface of open-vocab models; usually trails closed heads.

ladder.title: transfer protocols
ladder.takeaway: With few labels, reusing pretrained features (probe/FT) beats training from scratch.
